title: Jammy Juicy Thai Fish Kao Mun Gai
description: A pescatarian-friendly Thai dish featuring coco sugar and a jammy reduction, served with steamed chicken and fragrant rice.
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine mesh strainer and cook according to package instructions.
In a large saucepan, combine the water and coconut sugar and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer the sugar mixture for 10 minutes or until it reaches a jammy consistency.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium high heat and add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish balls to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes or until they are lightly browned.
Add the fish sauce and lime juice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil and cook for 1 minute.
To serve, place a scoop of the cooked jasmine rice on a plate and top with the fish ball mixture and a drizzle of the jammy reduction.
